Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security

Class AuthFilterConfig

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.security.AuthFilterConfig
public class AuthFilterConfig extends Object
DTO for a GeoServer authentication filter configuration. Maps GET/POST/PUT /rest/security/authfilters.

GeoServer uses a polymorphic envelope for authentication filters (XStream serializes each type under a JSON key equal to its FQCN). This DTO captures the getConfigClass() (JSON envelope key = filter FQCN) and getClassName() (filter implementation FQCN). Four factory methods (anonymous(java.lang.String), basic(java.lang.String, boolean), form(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, java.lang.String), rememberMe(java.lang.String)) cover the common cases. Extra type-specific fields are stored in getExtra().
